program: Season 9 Grants Council / Season 9 Governance Fund Missions
summary: The Grants Council seeks projects that grow Superchain adoption by increasing DEX liquidity in priority pairs and the fees generated from trading those pairs. Season 9 Governance Fund Missions fund the Grants Council (3.89M OP) and the Developer Advisory Board (0.98M OP) to make grants toward DEX TVL and trading volume per TVL for collateral-borrow pairs that exist on lending markets. Projects must have deployed their own contracts on eligible OP Chains in the Superchain Index that contribute revenue back to the Collective.

deadlines.name: Grant Review
deadlines.notes: Estimated 15 business days total: Submission Intake 5 days, GovNERDs Buffer 1 day, Ops Sync 1 day, Final Review 5 days, Final Decision + Buffer 2 days, Ops Wrap-up 1 day

deadlines.name: Measurement Date
deadlines.notes: End of Season 9; outcomes assessed by OP Labs or Open Source Observer

tracks.name: Grants Council applications (priority-pair liquidity and fees)
tracks.prize_text: Grant amounts not stated on the application post; Grants Council Season 9 Governance Fund budget is 3.89M OP
requirements: Grow Superchain adoption by increasing DEX liquidity in priority pairs and fees generated from trading those pairs
Target DEX TVL in Priority Pairs (Liquidity), formula ΔPairTVL = AvgPairTVL_end − AvgPairTVL_start, and/or DEX Fees in Priority Pairs, formula ΔPairFees = PairFees_end − PairFees_start

Eligible examples: incentive programs that increase and retain liquidity in priority pairs; vaults, strategies, or automation that improve depth (e.g. concentrated liquidity management); routing, aggregation, or UX that increases volume and fees in priority-pair pools; integrations that move existing liquidity into eligible priority pools and keep it there; tooling that tracks, monitors, or improves priority-pair TVL and fee performance

tracks.name: Grants Council Mission
tracks.prize_text: 3.89M OP from the Governance Fund (was ~6.29M OP in Season 8)
requirements: Grants Council makes grants on behalf of the Token House toward Season 9 success metrics

Primary: DEX TVL for collateral-borrow pairs that exist on lending markets (e.g. Morpho, Aave); both assets in a pair must be available on lending markets (example: WETH/USDC DEX pool where WETH is collateral and USDC is borrowed on Morpho)
Secondary: DEX trading volume per TVL for collateral-borrow pairs that exist on lending markets
Highest-priority liquidity pairs to be shown on a sheet updated on an ongoing basis
Incentive programs should be available to any chain in the Superchain contributing revenue back to the Collective (Superchain Index)
Projects eligible if they have deployed their own contracts on eligible OP Chains
Selection algorithm at Grants Council discretion; must be made public on the forum before the first round of selection
Selected projects assessed by OP Labs or Open Source Observer on contribution to the success metrics at End of Season 9

tracks.name: Developer Advisory Board Mission
tracks.prize_text: 0.98M OP from the Governance Fund (relative to 949k OP in Season 8)
requirements: Grants that drive developer adoption, either Audit grants or Mission Requests
Same primary metric: DEX TVL for collateral-borrow pairs on lending markets (e.g. Morpho, Aave), with both assets available on lending markets
Same secondary metric: DEX trading volume per TVL for those collateral-borrow pairs
Incentive programs recommended for any Superchain chain contributing revenue back to the Collective (Superchain Index)
Projects eligible if they have deployed their own contracts on eligible OP Chains; additional criteria may be set by the Developer Advisory Board
Selection algorithm at DAB discretion and must be published on the forum before the first round
Evaluation by OP Labs or Open Source Observer on the measurement date (End of Season 9)
Cited prior technical grant types include audits and Foundation Mission Requests such as Open-Source Monitoring & Alerting and Cross-Chain Key Management for Safe

judging_criteria.name: DEX TVL in Priority Pairs
judging_criteria.description: Application metric. ΔPairTVL = AvgPairTVL_end − AvgPairTVL_start. Deep liquidity reduces slippage, improves execution, and unlocks more onchain activity across the Superchain.

judging_criteria.name: DEX Fees in Priority Pairs
judging_criteria.description: Application metric. ΔPairFees = PairFees_end − PairFees_start. Fees measure real trading demand and willingness to pay to use Superchain venues for swaps.

judging_criteria.name: Primary: DEX TVL for collateral-borrow pairs
judging_criteria.description: Mission success metric for both Grants Council and Developer Advisory Board. Pairs must exist on lending markets; both assets must be available as collateral and borrow assets.

judging_criteria.name: Secondary: DEX trading volume per TVL
judging_criteria.description: Mission success metric. Trading volume per TVL for collateral-borrow pairs on lending markets, used as a proxy for demand-side activity and healthy ecosystem dynamics.

required_chains: Superchain Index chains that contribute revenue back to the Collective

deliverables.name: Grant application
deliverables.notes: Apply for a Grant; submissions close May 20th 2026. Specific application form fields are not stated.

deliverables.name: Contribution to measured outcomes
deliverables.notes: Selected projects assessed by OP Labs or Open Source Observer against the defined success metrics on the measurement date (End of Season 9).

deliverables.name: Public selection algorithm / rubric
deliverables.notes: Required of the Grants Council and Developer Advisory Board, not of applicants: selection algorithms must be made public on the forum before the first round of selection.

rules: Projects must target one of the stated metrics (priority-pair DEX TVL and/or fees on the application post; collateral-borrow DEX TVL and volume per TVL on the mission post).
For mission metrics, both assets in a liquidity pair need to be available on lending markets.
The Foundation recommends Season 9 incentive programs be available to any chain in the Superchain contributing revenue back to the Collective, corresponding to the Superchain Index.
Projects are eligible who have deployed their own contracts on eligible OP Chains.
Additional eligibility criteria may be determined by the Grants Council or the Developer Advisory Board.
Selection algorithms are at the discretion of the relevant body but must be published on the forum before the first round of selection.
Grants Council and Retro Funding are different initiatives; the Foundation runs Retro Funding and governance elects the Grants Council.
Priority liquidity pairs are maintained on an external sheet that is updated on an ongoing basis; the sheet contents are not included in the brief.

grant.objective: Grow Superchain adoption by increasing DEX liquidity and trading activity in priority and collateral-borrow pairs, via Grants Council user-incentive grants and Developer Advisory Board developer-adoption grants (audits or mission requests).
metrics: ΔPairTVL = AvgPairTVL_end − AvgPairTVL_start (DEX TVL in Priority Pairs)
ΔPairFees = PairFees_end − PairFees_start (DEX Fees in Priority Pairs)
Primary: DEX TVL for collateral-borrow pairs that exist on lending markets (e.g. Morpho, Aave)
Secondary: DEX trading volume per TVL for collateral-borrow pairs that exist on lending markets
Measurement date: End of Season 9, assessed by OP Labs or Open Source Observer
grant.budget: Grants Council 3.89M OP from the Governance Fund (about 6.29M OP in Season 8); Developer Advisory Board 0.98M OP from the Governance Fund (949k OP in Season 8). Per-project grant sizes are not stated.
milestone_rules: Grant review estimated at 15 business days: intake 5, GovNERDs buffer 1, ops sync 1, final review 5, final decision plus buffer 2, ops wrap-up 1.
Outcomes measured at End of Season 9.
Evaluation is based on ability to generate contribution toward the defined success metrics.
No applicant milestone payment schedule is stated.
eligibility: Own contracts deployed on eligible OP Chains.
Incentive programs recommended for any Superchain Index chain contributing revenue back to the Collective.
Additional criteria may be set by the Grants Council or Developer Advisory Board.
Collateral-borrow metric requires both assets of the pair to be available on lending markets.
